annotations.title: Horizon Europe Grant Budget & Overhead Calculator

description:
[Horizon Europe project budget & EU grant calculator. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates eligible direct personnel, subcontracting, and other direct costs, applying the mandatory 25% flat-rate indirect cost overhead and statutory reimbursement rates (100% RIA/CSA, 70% IA for profit entities) under the Horizon Europe Model Grant Agreement.
Usage: Use this tool to construct, normalize, and audit consortium budget proposals for European research grants.
Returns: JSON object with { projectAcronym: string, actionType: string, reimbursementRatePercent: number, budgetBreakdown: object, statutoryRulesApplied: array }.

workPackages.description: Array of Work Package expenditure allocations

monthlyPersonnelCostEur.description: Average monthly gross personnel cost in EUR

otherDirectCostsEur.description: Other direct consumables and goods in EUR

subcontractingCostsEur.description: Direct subcontracting costs in EUR (exempt from 25% overhead)

travelAndSubsistenceEur.description: Travel and subsistence costs in EUR

workPackageName.description: Work package designation (e.g. WP1 Management, WP2 R&D)
